name: pqsession-relay
description: Dumb relay for pqsession end-to-end sessions: forwards opaque ciphertext only; never sees keys or plaintext. v2: crash fix, backpressure, byte shaping, secure defaults, dynamic CSP hash, local vendoring of crypto libraries, optional native TLS. v2.2: voice-call hardening (stage-aware errors, ScriptProcessor fallback, iOS sample-rate rebuild, mic-ended teardown) with an end-to-end voice test.

scripts.test: node test-relay.mjs && node test-frontend.mjs && node test-voice.mjs
